svg.title: The right of way the player rides: a ballast shoulder of scattered chips, forty timber ties on a 48 px period, two rails whose head at local y 480 IS the level's ground line, a wire fence, a grade crossing with a gravel section road, a red-edged white CROSSBUCK and a two-lens flashing-light mast, and four telegraph poles with drooping wires on a 480 px period. The two periods are exact divisors of the 1920 px tile - 40 ties and 4 poles - so neither rhythm breaks at the seam, and the pole rhythm is what makes a train read as moving when the level's locomotion is `train` and the camera is doing all the work. Everything on this tile is a TYPE: a plain wooden pole, a plain wire fence, a crossbuck with no number plate and no lettering of any kind - a crossbuck is a shape, and it is the one object in this level that says RAILWAY without a word on it, which is exactly what a project that draws no lettering needs. World y 800..1320; opaque from world 1228, which is where the fields tile ends.
